metadata.question: Are more yellow areas visible in northern Lapland, Sweden, on October 10, 2016, than in September 2016

data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Define Northern Lapland, Sweden geometry
lapland_coords = [23.0, 68.0]  # [lon, lat]
lapland_geom = ee.Geometry.Point(lapland_coords).buffer(50000)  # 50km buffer

# 2. Sentinel-2 collection with cloud masking function
def maskClouds(img):
    qa = img.select('QA60')
    cloudBitMask = 1 << 10
    crrsBitMask = 1 << 11
    mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0).And(qa.bitwiseAnd(crrsBitMask).eq(0))
    return img.updateMask(mask)

# 3. September 2016 collection
sept_col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') \
    .filterDate('2016-09-01', '2016-09-30') \
    .filterBounds(lapland_geom) \
    .map(maskClouds)

sept_size = sept_col.size().getInfo()
print(f"September 2016 Images: {sept_size}")

if sept_size == 0:
    print("No September 2016 data found.")
    print("C1")
    exit()

# 4. October 10, 2016 collection
oct_col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') \
    .filterDate('2016-10-10', '2016-10-11') \
    .filterBounds(lapland_geom) \
    .map(maskClouds)

oct_size = oct_col.size().getInfo()
print(f"October 10, 2016 Images: {oct_size}")

if oct_size == 0:
    print("No October 10, 2016 data found.")
    print("C1")
    exit()

# 5. Create yellowness index: (B4+B3)/(B2) - captures red+green dominance
# Yellow = high Red + high Green, low Blue
def addYellowness(img):
    yellow = img.select('B4').add(img.select('B3')).divide(img.select('B2').add(1))
    return img.addBands(yellow.rename('yellowness'))

sept_with_yellow = sept_col.map(addYellowness).mean()
oct_with_yellow = oct_col.map(addYellowness).mean()

# 6. Calculate yellowness statistics
sept_yellow_stats = sept_with_yellow.select('yellowness').reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True),
    geometry=lapland_geom,
    scale=20,
    maxPixels=1e9
).getInfo()

oct_yellow_stats = oct_with_yellow.select('yellowness').reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True),
    geometry=lapland_geom,
    scale=20,
    maxPixels=1e9
).getInfo()

sept_mean = sept_yellow_stats.get('yellowness_mean')
sept_count = sept_yellow_stats.get('yellowness_count')

oct_mean = oct_yellow_stats.get('yellowness_mean')
oct_count = oct_yellow_stats.get('yellowness_count')

print(f"September Yellowness: {sept_mean:.3f} (Pixels: {int(sept_count) if sept_count else 0})")
print(f"October 10 Yellowness: {oct_mean:.3f} (Pixels: {int(oct_count) if oct_count else 0})")

# 7. Validation & Answer
if sept_count == 0 or oct_count == 0:
    print("No valid pixels after cloud masking.")
    print("C2")
elif sept_mean is None or oct_mean is None or sept_mean != sept_mean or oct_mean != oct_mean:
    print("Calculation failed (NaN or None).")
    print("C3")
elif oct_mean > sept_mean:
    print(f"October 10 has more yellow areas ({oct_mean:.3f} > {sept_mean:.3f})")
    print("A")
else:
    print(f"September has more yellow areas ({sept_mean:.3f} >= {oct_mean:.3f})")
    print("B")
